lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgTi4(OF)4 crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows that F centers adopt octahedral coordination with six Ti neighbors, while Mg and Ti centers each have eight geometric neighbors. The F octahedra connect through corner- and edge-sharing, and Mg polyhedra share corners and edges with F octahedra, forming a three-dimensional connected network.
